question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.
solution: The correct answer is** "Benevolent".** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The particular sentence describes that the ruler fostered progress in education, science, and development. • This conveys that the word used in the blank has a positive sense attached to it. • Let's understand the meaning of the correct option : • **Benevolent: **kind, friendly, and helpful to others(दयालु, मित्रवत और परोपकारी). The meaning conveys that the word **"Benevolent"** has a positive sense attached to it. • **Example**: *Ratan Tata is a **benevolent** philanthropist.* • Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3.**​ The complete passage is- *Nawab Mir Osman Ali Khan was the last ruler of Hyderabad, the largest princely state in British India. He ascended the throne (1) at the age of 25 and ruled Hyderabad for 37 years. He (2) was featured on the cover of Time magazine as the (3) richest person at the time. He was the 5th richest man in (4) the** history of mankind and the richest Indian who ever lived. He was a (5)benevolent ruler who encouraged education, science, and development.* ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's understand the **meaning of the other options:** • **Jealous: **unhappy and slightly angry because you wish you had someone else's qualities or advantages. (ईर्ष्यालु ) • **Cruel:** causing physical or mental pain or suffering to somebody/something.(किसी को शारीरिक अथवा मानसिक पीड़ा देनेवाला) • **Wicked: **morally bad; evil.(चरित्रहीन, भ्रष्‍ट; बुरा, दुष्‍ट) 4a:T6f9, **BODMAS RULE**:
